memory_candidates.content: In the agent-system core source store, context/schemas/state-schema.json and scripts/validate-state.sh's KNOWN_TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS/KNOWN_ENTRY_FIELDS arrays are held in lockstep by a BIDIRECTIONAL sorted-set drift test in scripts/tests/test-validate-state.sh. Adding, renaming, or removing any state.json field therefore requires editing BOTH files in the SAME commit -- a schema-only addition turns the drift test red, and a validator-only addition does too. Any plan that declares a new state.json field must treat the schema file and the validator's known-field array as one atomic batch, not two independent edits. The same pairing explains why an undeclared-but-written field (e.g. a producer writing a field no schema declares) surfaces as a Check 4 unknown-entry-field WARN rather than silently passing.
